definitions.explanation: A set of instructions for preparing a particular dish, including a list of ingredients and steps.

examples.japanese: このレシピは{簡単|かんたん}でおいしい。
examples.english: This recipe is easy and delicious.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}のレシピを{受|う}け{継|つ}いだ。
レシピ{通|どお}りに{作|つく}ったのに、なぜか{失敗|しっぱい}した。
examples.english: I made it exactly according to the recipe, but somehow it failed.

notes:
ORIGIN:
From English 'recipe'.

COLLOCATIONS:
・レシピを{見|み}る - to look at a recipe
・レシピ{通|どお}りに - according to the recipe
・レシピを{考|かんが}える - to think up a recipe
・オリジナルレシピ - original recipe
・{定番|ていばん}レシピ - standard/classic recipe
・レシピサイト - recipe website

RELATED VOCABULARY:
・{材料|ざいりょう} - ingredients
・{分量|ぶんりょう} - quantities/measurements
・{手順|てじゅん} - steps/procedure
・{調理|ちょうり}{時間|じかん} - cooking time
